# Prism Tide optical-input regression

Original three-level mirror-and-shutter puzzle, authored through dcc-mcp-godot 0.9.6 / Core and CLI 0.20.42 in Godot 4.6.3. Script creation, scene creation, attachment, scene save and project settings were performed through real MCP calls. Native procedural visuals use no third-party artwork.

This fixture is for pre-publication windowed rendering and real keyboard/mouse acceptance. It is not a final showcase submission. Model and reasoning effort attribution: Unknown.

Open project.godot in Godot 4.6.3. Click mirrors and shutters, or Tab to select and Space to turn. R resets. N advances only after connecting the receiver. Three levels; all start unsolved. Run headless with -- --test for 17 deterministic assertions.

Original source code: MIT, repository LICENSE. Original visual design: CC BY 4.0, attribute “Prism Tide, DCC-MCP showcase contributors”. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The fixture excludes editor caches, MCP addon copies, credentials, local paths and private logs. Godot is acquired separately from its official release and SHA-512 verified by CI. No application binary is redistributed.
